module "Rf_CustomDynamicInputs.dss"

product 0 Material "M_CustomDynamicInputs" backend=Graph
  %0 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1), ParameterName="A", SortPriority=0) : float @L2:C1 "A"
  %1 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(2), ParameterName="B", SortPriority=1) : float @L3:C1 "B"
  %2 = Reflected[Custom](X=%0, Y=%1, ClassSpecifier="Custom", Code="return X + Y;", OutputType="Float1") : float @L7:C17 "Opacity"
  %3 = MaterialSink(Opacity=%2) @L5:C1
  sink %3
